intent: ChatSession is the pure-Java aggregate record: session id, owner user id, tenant id, created timestamp, optimistic version. Invariant: belongs to exactly one user and tenant, ownership immutable; blank ids refused with IllegalArgumentException.

methods.signature: ChatSession(String sessionId, String ownerUserId, String tenantId, Instant createdAt, long version)
methods.semantics: rejects null or blank sessionId, ownerUserId and tenantId
